findings: Layer-isolation renders proved that the oblique medial slabs came from the body eyelid-wall topology rather than the independent caruncle object.
The correction is limited to 42 medial weighted aperture vertices and preserves the central and lateral collision-safe wall depth.
At the medial corner, ring one collapses 70 percent toward the aperture and ring two collapses 90 percent while retaining stepped depth.
Frames 1, 20, 33 and 61 record zero intersections with sclera, cornea, iris, upper lashes and lower lashes.
The slab width is reduced in oblique view, but the caruncle and wet-line anatomy still need a dedicated rebuild.
